_note: The glow colour of a real low-pressure discharge tube for elements whose neutral-line mix fails the lamp check (tools/build-data.mjs GLOW_FAILS). No source gives a measured chromaticity, so these CIE 1931 (x, y) are faithful renderings of the sourced descriptions (Gemini, 2026-11-22; RESEARCH.md › Answers, lamp colours). Why the line mix differs: a glow discharge is not in thermal equilibrium, and its ion lines (Kr II, Xe II) and the tube's pressure and current change the line strengths (NIST ASD line help).
